description:
During the ceasefire negotiations of the war, the protagonist Ethan (uke), whose family has fallen from grace, returns to his hometown after living as a wanderer. There, he learns that Jack (seme), who was once his servant in childhood, has returned as a war hero. After their reunion, Jack demands a forceful relationship from Ethan, using information about his sister who disappeared during the war and the sponsorship of his piano career as leverage.
